eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Granite, MT; at 8:47 AM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 8:47 AM AUG 10, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Granite County Sheriff has issued a YELLOW EVACUATION WARNING for residents south of the MT Highway 38 junction with Moose Lake Road, including Moose Lake Road, Ross Creek Road, Copper Creek Campground, and Moose Lake. Residents should prepare for a possible evacuation and be ready to leave immediately if conditions worsen.
